title: Open Mic @ The Down Under Lounge
event_description: Weekly open mic night featuring musicians and poets plus comedians and live painters. One of Omaha's longest-running open mic nights with drink specials and a welcoming atmosphere for all performers.
event_venue_information:
The Down Under Lounge

The Down Under Lounge has been a staple of Omaha's live music scene for years serving as an LGBTQIA-friendly neighborhood bar with exceptional service. The venue hosts live music Wednesday through Saturday featuring local and regional artists across genres. The intimate 100-capacity space creates an energetic atmosphere perfect for discovering new talent.

Weekly Events

In addition to the Wednesday open mic the venue features karaoke on Tuesdays and live band performances Thursday through Saturday. The bar is known for its award-winning Bloody Mary vodka infusions and extensive beer selection with over 45 options on tap and in bottles.

title: Music Open Mic @ Dubliner Pub
event_description: Music-focused open mic night for singer-songwriters and bands to test new material or jam with regulars. This Old Market pub offers an authentic Irish atmosphere with Guinness flowing freely.
event_venue_information:
Dubliner Pub

Located in the historic Old Market district inside a National Register building from 1894 Dubliner Pub brings authentic Irish pub culture to Omaha. The basement venue offers an intimate setting that has hosted live music for decades making it a cornerstone of the local music scene.

Live Music Schedule

The pub features live Irish music on Fridays and Saturdays along with performances on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Beyond music the venue is known for its Irish whiskey selection and traditional pub fare. The space can accommodate up to 100 guests and is available for private events.

title: Jazz Jam @ North Omaha Music and Arts
event_description: Live jazz showcase followed by free open jam session. Monday nights lean jazz-heavy encouraging musicians of all levels to collaborate and improvise in a supportive environment.
event_venue_information:
North Omaha Music and Arts (NOMA)

NOMA is a nonprofit organization dedicated to developing the next generation of musicians through world-class music education and performance opportunities. Located in the former Love's Jazz building on historic 24th Street NOMA celebrates the rich jazz heritage of North Omaha's music corridor.

Mission and Programs

Executive Director Dana Murray former drummer for Norah Jones and Wynton Marsalis leads comprehensive music programs in jazz blues funk and soul. The academy features state-of-the-art labs for piano broadcasting bass and percussion plus plans for a 450-seat venue and recording studio.

Annual Events

NOMA hosts the annual NOMAFEST at Turner Park bringing world-renowned jazz blues and funk artists to Omaha each summer. Past performers include Eric Gales Ghost-Note Lakecia Benjamin and Heidi Martin celebrating the legacy of jazz musicians who once entertained on 24th Street.

title: Open Mic @ The Nifty Bar
event_description: Rotating open mic night led by local artists in this historic Benson neighborhood bar. The cozy colorful cocktail bar welcomes all types of performances in a warm intimate setting.
event_venue_information:
The Nifty Bar

Around since the 1930s The Nifty Bar proudly claims to be Benson before Benson was Benson. This quaint neighborhood bar offers a neighborly atmosphere where regulars and newcomers alike feel welcome creating a true community gathering space.

Entertainment and Atmosphere

The bar features live bands monthly along with weekly quiz nights darts pool life-sized Jenga and an outdoor covered patio. The Nifty is known for its excellent selection of local craft beers and expertly crafted cocktails with margaritas being a house specialty. Happy hour runs Monday through Friday from 4-7 PM with $2 pints and well drinks.

title: Open Mic @ Shakedown Street Tavern
event_description: The OG open mic night in Omaha continuing the legacy from Barley Street Tavern days. Informal walk-up format with no advance sign-ups hosting musicians comedians and Americana songwriters.
event_venue_information:
Shakedown Street Tavern

A Grateful Dead-inspired bar in downtown Benson Shakedown Street Tavern carries on the musical tradition of its predecessor Barley Street Tavern. The venue has been a hotspot for live music in the Benson Creative District for years offering an intimate side room perfect for performances.

Live Music Programming

The tavern features live music performances nightly showcasing local and regional artists performing folk jazz blues and pop. Beyond the Monday open mic the venue hosts various touring acts and special events throughout the week. The space maintains an authentic dive bar atmosphere with a dedicated music community.

title: Open Mic @ Brokedown Palace
event_description: Musician-recommended open mic night in a Grateful Dead and Huskers themed bar. The venue features a living room feel with couches up front and a traditional bar area in back creating a comfortable performance space.
event_venue_information:
Brokedown Palace

Combining the flower power of the Grateful Dead with Nebraska Huskers pride Brokedown Palace creates a unique bar experience on Maple Street. The venue features Grateful Dead memorabilia concert posters local art and a large aquarium creating an eclectic comfortable atmosphere.

Weekly Entertainment

Tuesday nights feature open mic with 15-minute performance slots plus $1 tacos $3 Modelos and $5 margaritas. Wednesday brings karaoke hosted by Zach Kurmel while Thursdays feature live music performances and Ladies Night. The bar is dog-friendly with water bowls provided and offers a patio area for outdoor enjoyment.

Special Events

Brokedown Palace hosts Eva Bleu Band every Monday night from 8-10 PM bringing raspy soul and fuzzy funk riffs to the stage. Thursday nights include Patio Flow gatherings with hoopers flow artists and drum circles creating a festival atmosphere under the stars.

title: Bluegrass Jam @ American Legion Hall Post #1
event_description: Monthly bluegrass and old-time music gathering featuring one-hour live band performance followed by open jam sessions. Hosted by Great Plains Bluegrass & Old-Time Music Association.
hosts: Great Plains Bluegrass & Old-Time Music Association
event_venue_information:
American Legion Hall Post #1

This community hall located two blocks north of Dodge Street serves as the home for the Great Plains Bluegrass & Old-Time Music Association monthly gatherings. The space provides an accessible venue for preserving and promoting traditional bluegrass and old-time music in the Omaha area.

GPBOTMA Events

The Great Plains Bluegrass & Old-Time Music Association has been dedicated to preserving bluegrass and old-time music for over 40 years. Monthly meetings run from October through May featuring professional performances followed by open jam sessions where musicians of all skill levels can participate. Admission is $3 for members $5 for non-members with children 12 and under free.
